parameters.content:
## 🎯 What this workflow does

Once a day it reads your `Invoices` sheet and chases whatever needs chasing, climbing a polite-to-firm ladder:

• **3 days before due** — a friendly heads-up
• **On the due date** — a short reminder
• **3 days overdue** — a firmer note
• **7 days overdue** — a final notice

The moment a row's Status says **Paid**, the chasing stops — every stage checks the sheet first. Each stage fires **once** per invoice, every send is written to the `Chase Log` tab, and on Monday mornings you get one summary of everything still outstanding.

**Follow the sticky notes in order: SETUP first, then test, then activate.**

Built by RozContent — free template. The paid version adds automatic invoice creation from your accounting tool, card-payment links inside every reminder, and a live "who owes what" view.

## 🛠️ SETUP — do these before activating

1. **Google Sheet:** one sheet, two tabs named exactly `Invoices` and `Chase Log` (headers are in this template's README). Paste its ID into all three Google Sheets nodes (replace `PASTE_YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`).
2. **Due dates** must be `YYYY-MM-DD`. Amounts are plain numbers — set `config_currency` and the emails will show it (e.g. `$`, `£`, `PKR `).
3. **Credentials:** click each Google Sheets / Gmail node and connect YOUR Google account. The placeholders in this file are dummies — n8n will prompt you.
4. **CONFIG node:** owner email, business name, currency, and `config_payment_instructions` — one clear line telling clients exactly how to pay (bank details or a payment link). It is pasted into every reminder, so make it copy-paste easy.
5. **The one habit that matters:** when an invoice is paid, set its Status to `Paid`. That single word stops all future chases.
6. **Test** with the fake invoices in the README before switching Active on.

## ⚠️ Honest limits (read once)

- The chaser only knows what the **sheet** knows. If a client pays but nobody marks the row **Paid**, the ladder keeps climbing — keep the sheet current, or have the paid version wired to your accounting tool.
- **Email only**, from your Gmail. No SMS, no WhatsApp, no phone calls. Right for most clients; chronic late-payers may need a human conversation on top.
- The ladder stops at the 7-day final notice. It does not add late fees, pause anyone's work or start collections — those are business decisions, and they stay human.
- If n8n misses a day (server down), the due-date reminder for that day is skipped; the overdue stages still fire, because they watch a window, not a single day.

assignments.value: Bank transfer — the account details are on your invoice PDF.

value.Detail: ={{ 'Automatic ' + $('Plan Invoice Chases').item.json.action + ' reminder sent to ' + $('Plan Invoice Chases').item.json.Email }}
